newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers buys natural gas properties.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers buys natural gas properties.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Monday it has entered into an agreement to acquire natural gas producing properties in the Fontenelle Field, Green River Basin, in Lincoln County, Wyoming, for $13 million.
The company declined to release the name of the selling party.
Once the acquisition is completed, Cross Timbers will own more than 97 percent of the Fontenelle unit and 100 percent of the related gathering and compression facilities.

Estimated proved reserves attributable to the acquisition total 25 billion cubic feet of natural gas with current production averaging 1.8 million cubic feet of gas per day from 71 gross, or 13.7 net, wells.
The deal is expected to close around December 1. It will be funded by using bank credit lines, the company said.
